```yaml
name: Claude PR Critique

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  critique:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        npm install --prefix web
        npm install --prefix apps
        npm install --prefix electron

    - name: Run tests and checks
      run: |
        npm run lint --prefix web
        npm run typecheck --prefix web
        npm test --prefix web
        npm run lint --prefix apps
        npm run typecheck --prefix apps
        npm run lint --prefix electron
        npm run typecheck --prefix electron
        npm test --prefix electron

    - name: Request critique from Claude
      id: claude-comment
      uses: claude-inc/github-action@v1
      with:
        api-key: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_API_KEY }}
        prompt: "Please provide a brief critique of this pull request."
        model: "claude-2"
        max-tokens: 500
        temperature: 0.7
        top-p: 0.9
        stop-sequence: "\n\n"

    - name: Post critique as comment
      if: success()
      run: |
        echo "::add-comment::${{ steps.claude-comment.outputs.response }}"
```
